Moderate multiple inputs in a single request

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ModerationRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ModerationRequest.from_json('{"input":["Hello world","Nice weather today"],"model":"omni-moderation-latest"}')
    result = await client.moderate(req)
    print(result.results)
    print(result.results[0].flagged)

asyncio.run(main())
```
